resources.string: To list games stored on shared storage (for example in a Games folder on the internal storage), allow shadPS4 to access all files.\n\nGames kept inside the app folder work without this permission.
Open Settings, then Apps, shadPS4, and enable \"All files access\".

shadPS4 needs storage permission to read PS4 game images (.pkg / .pfs / EBOOT.BIN). You can place games in any of these locations:

• /storage/emulated/0/Games/shadPS4/
• /storage/emulated/0/Download/shadPS4/
• The app private directory (no permission needed)

Please tap "Allow" in the next system dialog.
Storage permission denied. Games may not be readable; please re-grant the permission in System Settings.

This is a PS4 emulator for Android.

First-time setup:
1) Grant storage permission (to read game files)
2) Add the folder containing your games under Settings → Game Folders

Then pick a game in Big Picture mode to launch.
